description: Imports and Exports Control Department - Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 04 of 2022
categorisation: This gazette content involves the promulgation of new regulations under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969. It establishes legal/regulatory frameworks for import control by deleting specific entries from previous regulations and setting new clearance procedures. While it mentions Minister Basil Rajapaksa, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only his title "Minister of Finance"), and the primary focus is on regulatory changes rather than government personnel or structure. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements.
